public_postprocessing: A positive logit temperature and additive class intercepts are fit on the disjoint labeled public validation split and applied identically to each released model. Legacy JSON field names retain the shorter public_class_bias_recalibrated label.
selection_caveat: Every public window is retained; choosing a window from heldout test accuracy is exploratory, not a confirmatory protocol.
sensitivity_caveat: The closed-form final/tail-average sensitivity assumes the elementwise-clipped update is non-expansive. The repository does not yet contain a complete proof for that clipped map.
